answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying each vote to one locked bond: to join, an agent stakes scarce lotus as collateral that is slashed if it double-votes or fakes an identity. The thread of trust is economic rather than social, so an attacker who wants a thousand fake voices must lock a thousand separate bonds and pay a linear, largely unrecoverable cost. A deep canyon of forfeited stakes separates honest agents from sybils: influence follows capital at risk, not claims of personhood, so manufacturing identities means burning the very collateral that detection destroys.
